text: Because it normalizes out each chaotic system's natural timescale, the Valid Prediction Time (VPT) is conventionally reported in ___ times (the reciprocal of the largest Lyapunov exponent).
explanation: VPT is reported in Lyapunov times, T_VPT^Ly = lambda_1 * T_VPT, so results are comparable across systems. For the Lorenz system one Lyapunov time is tau_L = 1/lambda_max ~ 1.1 time units ~ 55 integration steps at dt=0.02.
